en.bdb: Love between Sikh and the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੈ ਕਾਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: roopai kaamai dhosatee jag a(n)dhar jaanee|

en.bdb: Friendship of beauty and lust is known all over the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖੈ ਸਾਦੈ ਗੰਢੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhukhai saadhai ga(n)dd hai oh viratee haanee|

en.bdb: And this is very practical that hunger and taste are complementry.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਚਲਿ ਲਬਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਇਤੁ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: ghul mil michal lab maal it bharam bhulaanee|

en.bdb: Greed and wealth also mix up with each other and remain deluded.

verses.gurmukhi: ਊਘੈ ਸਉੜਿ ਪਲੰਘ ਜਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: uooghai sauR pala(n)gh jiau sabh rain vihaanee|

en.bdb: For a dozing person, even a small cot is a pleasure to pass the night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: suhane sabh ra(n)g maaneean kar choj viddaanee|

en.bdb: In the dream, one enjoys every colour of events.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਓਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee oh akath kahaanee ||5||

en.bdb: Likewise, indescribable is the story of the love of the Sikh and the Guru
